question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution: The correct answer is** "Escaped".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence ***"I couldn't hear it very well, but there was a story on the news about an elephant that had (5) ________ from a local circus."*** is saying that **he heard a news story on the radio, where he got the news about an elephant that had escaped from a local circus.** • The word **'escaped' **means having broken free from confinement. • **Example: ***The bird **escaped** from the cage.* • ​​​With the given meaning and example we can say that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is** "Escaped".** • The correct answer is **option 2.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Let's understand the meaning of the other given options : • **Captured : **to take someone as a prisoner, or to take something into your possession, especially by force.(किसी को कैदी के रूप में लेना, या किसी चीज को अपने कब्जे में लेना, विशेष रूप से बल द्वारा।) • **Absconded: **to go away suddenly and secretly in order to escape from somewhere. (फरार) • **Released: **to give freedom or free movement to someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को आज़ादी या आज़ादी देना) **Correct Passage*****: **The radio was already on. The radio comes **on **automatically at 7 o'clock to wake me **up.** I looked at the clock.** It **was already ten past seven. I had to get up quickly. I went into the shower, and I could **hear **the news on the radio. I couldn't hear it very well, but there was a story on the news about an elephant that had** escaped **from a local circus.* 48:T712, The position values of the letters, according to the English alphabet series:
